summary: Acadia Realty Trust filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 9,000,000 common shares via forward sale agreements with Bank of America, Jefferies, Truist, and Wells Fargo. The last sale price was $22.59/share. The company expects net proceeds of ~$195.6M upon physical settlement within 12 months. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No special situation—this is a routine equity shelf takedown to raise capital while maintaining REIT status.
